More information provided By the  customer

  • Sleeves: Smooth leather, not woven, matching the dark brown/black colour of the body.

    Collar: Smooth leather classic shirt-style collar as shown in the picture. Structured but not oversized.

    Fit: Tailored/slim fit with a clean silhouette. Waist/belt length rather than a long jacket. I do not want it oversized or boxy.

    Front zip: Premium-quality metal zip, preferably YKK Excella or equivalent, in antique/dark brass rather than shiny silver.

    Pockets: Two clean vertical/slightly angled welt pockets with smooth leather surrounds as shown in the reference.

    Cuffs: Simple smooth-leather cuffs like the reference. No biker-style zipped cuffs.

    Hem: Straight, clean hem without elastic or ribbing.

    Lining: High-quality breathable lining, with at least two internal pockets.

    The most important things for me are the fine tight weave, premium leather quality, subtle black/brown patina, clean construction and tailored fit.

    Please do not add quilting, patches, logos, unnecessary seams or motorcycle-style details.

title: Design Your Own Leather Jacket
body_html:
Share your design idea and place the order, and our team will guide you through the entire customization process.

Once your order is received, our design team will review your requirements and contact you to confirm the details. We will create a design mockup for approval, discuss materials, colors, sizing, and any personalization such as logos, embroidery, or patches. After your approval, the jacket will move into production.


How It Works

  1. Place Your Order – Submit your request and upload your design or describe your idea.

  2. Design Consultation – Our team contacts you to finalize details.

  3. Mockup Approval – You review and approve the design before production.

  4. Production & Delivery – Your jacket is handcrafted and shipped after quality checks.
